dialogs.about: 손님이 오기 전에 며느리와 손님방을 정리해요

lines.en: Mother, the guest room looks messy.
Yes. Let's change the sheets today.
Where do you keep the clean sheets?
In the closet, beside the blankets.
Is this mattress new? It feels soft.
No, I bought it two years ago.
Should I iron these wrinkles?
Yes, please. That is very kind.
Oh, there is a small stain here.
Thank you. I will wash it with bleach.
Hello. Can you clean this coat?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 코트 세탁해 주실 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. Oh, there is a big stain.
I dropped my tea cup yesterday.
Don't worry. Our detergent is very good.
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요. 우리 세제가 아주 좋아요.

lines.en: Will the bleach change the color?
No, Ma'am. We are careful with colors.
Thank you. Can you iron the wrinkles too?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 주름도 다려 주실 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. We will put it on a hanger.
That is good. When can I come?
On Friday. Your coat will look tidy.
